name: single leg hip thrust v. 2
description: A one-legged hip thrust with your upper back on a bench, a second variation. It hits the glutes hard without any equipment.
instructions: Rest your upper back on a bench with one foot flat on the floor.
Lift the other leg off the floor, knee bent or straight.
Drive through the planted heel and raise your hips.
Squeeze your glute at the top until your torso is level.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.
